description: A standalone Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod overhauling brewing and alchemy. Every drop counts — the stand teaches its own recipes, every vanilla effect becomes brewable, known recipes batch to six bottles, and antidotes cure one affliction at a time. Part of the Concord collection.

mods.name: Distillation
mods.description: An alchemy overhaul for Minecraft. The brewing stand teaches its own recipes, every vanilla effect becomes brewable, known recipes batch to six bottles over a heated cauldron, utility potions last honest durations, and antidotes cure one affliction at a time.
